validatedTree: baseCommit plus the changes identified by sourceFileSha256 (documentation excluded)
scope: crates/miy/src/policy.rs decides app-level authorization (Use, Develop, Manage(action), FollowJob, Request(action)) as pure functions over facts loaded once per principal
Removed domain::authorize, access_decision, can_manage, manage, manage_action and runtime::authorize_request/authorize_job; about 30 call sites name an action instead
Apps, installations and runtime job pages filter by policy-allowed (app, environment) arrays instead of SQL permission predicates; installation display values come from the same decisions
The default installation list loads facts once instead of running per-row checks; delegation checks and delegation creation read the same policy definitions
behaviorChanges: Delegated credentials: canManage is the Manage(read) decision (previously always false); canPromote is the prod Request(promote) decision, which also needs read, the deploy grant and miy.dev (previously false on the default list and delegation scope only on the paged list); acceptance follows canManage
Display values now also require miy.dev on the paged list; no HTTP principal that reaches these lists lacks it today

checks.newObservation: default and paged installation lists, installation and job details, job lists and display values agree for administrators, deployers, developers, users, strangers and delegated credentials with and without read, with the company switch off and on
